tldr: Independent evaluation estimates the AUTOC of the supplied prioritization rule. On the maintained generated-score fibre class, oracle displacement has leading term \(f(1)v(1)(a^2/2r)\log(r/a)\), with a uniform remainder and a regular Qini comparator. When \(v(1)=0\), a finite quadratic coefficient and sharp cubic remainder yield the smaller centering frontier \(\sqrt N a^2/r\to0\); the full-class frontier is \(\sqrt N(a^2/r)\log(r/a)\to0\). Uniform harmonic-rank projection and observed tail-sum studentization give the stable oracle-centered limit and an oracle interval with asymptotic coverage at least ninety percent. Positive results concern the declared fibre certificate. The explicit-witness centering obstructions transfer to every generated-score superclass containing the corresponding benchmark arrays.
